Chapter 1171 - 30: Before I Perish (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 1171: Chapter 30: Before I Perish (Please Subscribe)

"Escape!"

"Escape!"

"Escape!"

Great Saint Hunxiao and Jade Qilin Great Saint burned their physical and soul origins, hoping to distance themselves from that towering and powerful man.

Swoosh.

Time and space turned into a prison, Xuanhuang Qi suffused, trapping the two supreme great saints within.

"Xuanhuang!"

Great Saint Hunxiao roared, the time and space around him exploded in surges, trying to disperse the Xuanhuang prison, but unable to shake it even slightly.

Jade Qilin Great Saint looked grave, he glanced not far away, now they had returned to their original place, Xuanhuang stood there quietly, gazing at them indifferently.

As if overlooking them from above.

"Xuanhuang, you haven’t stepped into the thirteenth layer yet forcibly break out of the time loop, you’re courting death."

Jade Qilin Great Saint said solemnly, staring fixedly at the towering, powerful man.

The towering, powerful man said nothing, his expression calm, flipping his raised right hand.

Immediately, the Xuanhuang cage trapping the two supreme great saints began to collapse, and within it, Great Saint Hunxiao and Jade Qilin Great Saint also started to collapse.

"Last time you survived, this time you won’t."

The towering, powerful man’s gaze fixed, Great Saint Hunxiao and Jade Qilin Great Saint struggled desperately but still turned to dust within two or three breaths, their bodies and soul bodies within their universes all disintegrated to dust.

"Dead?"

Not far away, Lin Yuan took a deep breath.

Two supreme great saints, just like that, dead?

Lin Yuan had fought against Great Saint Hunxiao, knowing well the strength of this supreme great saint, far surpassing his own, willing to pay the price, he could completely suppress him in a short time.

But this supreme great saint, could not last two or three breaths against Xuanhuang’s hand?

Nor could Jade Qilin Great Saint, who was no weaker than Great Saint Hunxiao?

Two supreme great saints, in Lin Yuan’s hands, seemed like those Chaos Venerables in front of him?

Without any ability to resist?

"The strength of an Invincible Great Saint, is it so much stronger than a Supreme Great Saint?"

Lin Yuan found it hard to believe.

He also concluded Xuanhuang hadn’t stepped into the thirteenth layer, still at the twelfth, but this strength was too strong, supreme great saints of the same level were like ants.

"No."

"An Invincible Great Saint shouldn’t be this strong."

Lin Yuan was certain in his heart, Invincible Great Saints were indeed stronger than Supreme Great Saints, able to sweep the latter, but the difference in strength couldn’t be this vast.

"Is it because of the time loop?"

Lin Yuan looked at the towering, powerful man, at this moment Xuanhuang’s state was very strange, between the twelfth and thirteenth layer.

Neither having stepped into the thirteenth layer nor surpassed the twelve-layer category.

...

After Great Saint Hunxiao and Jade Qilin Great Saint were completely annihilated.

The towering, powerful man retracted his right hand, glanced at Lin Yuan, and said with a smile, "I’ll go deal with some hidden dangers, I’ll be back soon."

"Alright."

Lin Yuan nodded.

Looking at the towering, powerful man disappearing from the original place.

...

Outside the Xuanhuang Universe.

The Chaos Venerables didn’t know what had happened within the universe, still discussing the scene of Great Saint Hunxiao and Jade Qilin Great Saint entering.

In the distance, several special existences like the Eye of Myriad Laws had a solemn expression.

At this moment.

The towering, powerful man appeared at the entrance of the universe.

In a daze, the Xuanhuang Universe behind him started to spread infinitely, encompassing the four directions of time-space, Chaos Void.

"Who is that?"

"Why did he come out?"

"Where are the two supreme great saints?"

Many Chaos Venerables were still confused, not reacting.

"Indeed, it is Xuanhuang!"

The long knife broken in two said in a low voice, even though it was already certain, three million Cosmic Eras ago, the Xuanhuang who attempted the thirteenth layer reappeared, seeing it in person now still made its heart a bit unsettled.

As a special existence, they had witnessed too much, even personally experienced the birth of thirteenth layer time life.

But to forcibly break out of the time loop? It was very rare, one, it was extremely difficult, and two, the cost was too high.

The forcible breakout here was not a normal breakthrough of the time loop constraint, but to break out in another way.

"Xuanhuang, I didn’t expect the Heart Demon effect was so great."

The Eye of Myriad Laws sighed, he had told Lin Yuan before that Xuanhuang’s chance to break the time loop was very low because this supreme great saint’s Heart Demon was just too heavy.

Now it seems, indeed so.

"Chaos Void..."

The towering, powerful man appeared outside the Xuanhuang Universe, took a deep breath.

In an instant, the Chaos Qi of several Void Domains around him, along with the thin Chaos Qi of the Desolate Void, was completely swallowed into his mouth.

The towering, powerful man glanced at the positions of several special existences like the Eye of Myriad Laws, did not pay much attention, but extended his right hand: "Sword, come to me."

Xuanhuang Qi gathered, forming the shadow of a long sword.

The long sword was similar to the Sword of the Xuanhuang that Lin Yuan obtained, but in a phantom state.

Even so, an unprecedented sharpness condensed within the phantom long sword.

"Slash!"

The towering, powerful man slashed two swords deep into the Chaos Void.

...

A highly secretive Void Secret Realm.

Great Saint Hunxiao looked solemn, gazing distantly in a certain direction, and murmured, "Xuanhuang?"

As a peerless Great Saint who had lived through tens of millions of Cosmic Eras, Great Saint Hunxiao naturally had many means of self-preservation, having four true bodies and as many as fifty-eight avatars.

Four true bodies and fifty-eight avatars; as long as one was alive, Great Saint Hunxiao could quickly recover.

As for the means of self-preservation? In the boundless Chaos Void, Great Saint Hunxiao had left countless means for survival.

Should all true bodies and avatars perish, the self-preservation means would be triggered, allowing for a resurrection.

"Thirty million Cosmic Eras ago, you killed all my true bodies and broke my many survival methods, and I had no choice but to reincarnate. But now? Can you still force me into reincarnation?"

Great Saint Hunxiao sat there quietly.

At this moment.

A sword light came slashing towards Great Saint Hunxiao through the causal time-space.

"What?"

Before Great Saint Hunxiao could react, his flesh and soul were quickly annihilated under the sword light.

At the same time.

The third true body of Great Saint Hunxiao, located deep in a Spatial-Temporal Maze, was likewise obliterated by a sword light.

The fourth true body was slashed.

The first avatar hidden deep within the Taiyuan Ruins was slashed.

The second avatar hiding in a special place was slashed.

The third avatar within a Mysterious Space was slashed.

...

At the same instant, all three of Great Saint Hunxiao’s true bodies and fifty-eight avatars were completely slashed.

In the boundless Chaos Void, the many survival means left behind by Great Saint Hunxiao were similarly met with sword light and annihilated.

...

As Great Saint Hunxiao’s true bodies, avatars, and survival methods were extinguished.

The same fate befell Jade Qilin Great Saint, whose many true bodies and survival methods were equally slashed and annihilated under the causal time-space sword lights with no resistance.

...

"What happened?"

"This type of causal time-space fluctuation?"

"Who is it? Xuanhuang?"

The disappearance of the two peerless Great Saints from causality and their complete fall immediately alarmed the ancient Great Saints within the Chaos Void. Many peerless Great Saints, who were in seclusion, preparing for the final breakthrough to the Thirteenth Level, were stirred.

"That aura, is it Xuanhuang?"

"His Excellency Xuanhuang? The peerless Great Saint ruling over tens of thousands of Void Domains?"

"Wasn’t it said he was breaking through to the Thirteenth Level?"

...

Some ancient peerless Great Saints, even if they were not from the same era as His Excellency Xuanhuang, had heard of this peerless Great Saint, and now were extremely shocked.

In the long history of the Chaos Void, there indeed had been instances where peerless Great Saints fell, but those were during highly unusual times, and the fallen Great Saints only perished after numerous fierce battles.

And whether they truly fell, no one knew, because, at the last moment, a peerless Great Saint could still reincarnate.

Once reincarnated, a peerless Great Saint would lose all, including their flesh and soul, but would also completely sever their own causality.

Great Saint Hunxiao and Jade Qilin Great Saint had used this method to escape Xuanhuang’s pursuit.

But now?

Their causal ties disappeared far too quickly.

"Xuanhuang... Xuanhuang is clearing the accounts, clearing out all the Great Saints opposing the Profound Xuanhuang lineage."

Numerous peerless Great Saints were tremendously shocked but didn’t dare to step forward. Even thirty million Cosmic Eras ago, Xuanhuang had the strength of an Invincible Great Saint, and with enough time, would gain the recognition of all peerless Great Saints.

The strength shown now far exceeded the scope of a normal peerless Great Saint; at this moment, no peerless Great Saint dared to stand out.

.....

Outside the Xuanhuang Universe.

A tall and mighty man sensed carefully and slashed out another three swords.

After three swords, the causal ties of three more ancient peerless Great Saints vanished completely, unable even to reincarnate.

In fact, even over thirty million Cosmic Eras ago, the reincarnation of Great Saint Hunxiao and Jade Qilin Great Saint had been Xuanhuang’s doing, leaving them no retreat, with all true bodies and avatars annihilated, forcing them to reincarnate.

Now? With merely one true body slashed, Great Saint Hunxiao and Jade Qilin Great Saint weren’t yet at the end of their roads and naturally didn’t reincarnate immediately.

Who could have thought that the sword from the tall and mighty man would wield such terrifying power, instantly annihilating all true bodies, avatars, and survival methods.

...

After five sword strikes, the longsword in the hands of the tall and mighty man dissipated, and he immediately turned and stepped into the Xuanhuang Universe.

Deep within the Xuanhuang Universe.

Lin Yuan looked grave.

"The causal ties of Great Saint Hunxiao and Jade Qilin Great Saint... have completely vanished?" Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Having battled these two Great Saints, causality naturally arose, allowing Lin Yuan to determine whether they still existed through the causal ties.

Of course, it was only possible to determine their existence; with Lin Yuan’s current mastery of causality, he couldn’t yet lock onto the location coordinates of the two peerless Great Saints.

After all, the two peerless Great Saints would intentionally obscure their own causality.

Failing to lock onto their locations through causality, however, still allowed him to determine whether they were alive by the existence of causality.

Now the causal ties of Great Saint Hunxiao and Jade Qilin Great Saint had vanished utterly, as if wiped from existence.

As Lin Yuan’s thoughts spread out.

The tall and mighty man appeared not far away, stepping a stride to stand before Lin Yuan.

"I know you have many questions."

The tall and mighty man looked at Lin Yuan with a smile: "Don’t worry, I’ll explain everything to you."

After speaking, the tall and mighty man paused for a moment, then added:

"Before I vanish."
